meta.name: The Life You Wanted
meta.description: Gloria is finally happy after transitioning and settling down — until a longtime friend reappears with disrupting news and throws her world into chaos.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Gloria's peaceful life is punctured when Marina, once her closest friend, arrives — pregnant and with two kids. Soon, her real intentions surface.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Learning the truth angers Andrea and makes Sergio feel unsure about his role in the family. Pietro is determined to find Marina.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Marina asks Gloria to stay by her side when she most needs it. Confused, Andrea puts himself in danger. Doctors discover something troubling.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: A medical decision leads Marina to put the family on edge. Gloria tries to get along better with Andrea, while Pietro's obsession gets more dangerous.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Everyone is shocked after the latest events, but Gloria feels especially skeptical. Sergio still has his doubts about her, so he tells an important lie.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Gloria takes the family to a safe place, where she faces some painful memories. Eva shows her bravery, but Pietro is still on the loose.
